limitations: This is a public testing preview, not a production, emergency-service, survivor-facing, UNICEF-approved, or Google Play release.

Build 21 has not yet been installed on a physical phone. It has passed automated build and signature checks only; on-device testing, TalkBack and the 2-3 GB, 4 GB and 6-8 GB device matrix are pending.
Account sign-in, report submission and sync do not work yet because SafeRide's servers are not online, and new account sign-up is turned off. Reports are saved as encrypted drafts on the phone.
It is signed with a different key from the August v0.5.8 preview, so it cannot install over v0.5.8. Uninstalling v0.5.8 deletes that app's local drafts.
The optional on-device assistant downloads 5,071,837,136 bytes (4.72 GiB), needs about 5.22 GiB free storage (8-10 GB free recommended) and an arm64 device.
Use synthetic test reports only; do not enter real survivor reports, evidence, credentials, or exact locations during unsupervised testing.
